purpose: Twelve original NativeZipper checks:7 shuffled four-tape batches with varied widths0..5;one widths32..35 batch;one empty batch;3 scratch marker removals with negative/zero/positive positions. All selected cells blank,outside tapes retained,all heads and halt checked.
source:
import TransposeFollowup.NativeBatchErase
import TransposeFollowup.NativeUnprepare
open TransposeFollowup FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine

def blank (w : Tape Bool) : Bool :=
  w.left.all (fun x => decide (x=.blank)) && w.right.all (fun x => decide (x=.blank))
def slots : Fin 4 ↪ Fin 8 := ⟨![7,2,5,0],by decide +kernel⟩
def frameTape (p : Fin 8) : Tape Bool := Counter.marked ((List.range (p.val+1)).map (fun j => decide (j%2=0)))
def heads (p : Fin 8) : Int := 17*(p.val : Int)-61

def check (profile : Nat) (wide : Bool) : Bool :=
  let words := fun j : Fin 4 =>
    let len := if wide then 32+j.val else (j.val+profile)%6
    (List.range len).map (fun i => decide ((i+3*j.val+profile)%3=0))
  let bank := fun p : Fin 8 => match (List.finRange 4).find? (fun j => decide (slots j=p)) with
    | some j => Counter.marked (words j)
    | none => frameTape p
  let count := 4*((List.finRange 4).map (fun j => (words j).length)).sum+20
  let c := NativeZipper.run (NativeBatchErase.program slots) count
    (NativeBatchErase.zipperCfg (NativeBatchErase.entry 4 0) bank heads)
  decide (c.core.pc=.done) && (List.finRange 8).all (fun p =>
    decide (c.pos p=heads p) &&
    if (List.finRange 4).any (fun j => decide (slots j=p)) then blank (c.core.tapes p)
    else decide (c.core.tapes p=bank p))

def emptySlots : Fin 0 ↪ Fin 8 := ⟨Fin.elim0,by intro i; exact Fin.elim0 i⟩
def emptyCheck : Bool :=
  let c := NativeZipper.run (NativeBatchErase.program emptySlots) 0
    (NativeBatchErase.zipperCfg (NativeBatchErase.entry 0 0) frameTape heads)
  decide (c.core.pc=.done) && (List.finRange 8).all (fun p => decide (c.pos p=heads p) && decide (c.core.tapes p=frameTape p))

def markerCheck (pos : Int) : Bool :=
  let c := NativeZipper.run NativeUnprepare.program 2 (NativeUnprepare.cfg 0 BinaryCarry.preparedOutput (fun _ => pos))
  decide (c.core.pc=2) && blank (c.core.tapes 0) && decide (c.pos 0=pos)

#eval ((List.range 7).map (fun p => check p false),check 2 true,emptyCheck,([-80,0,90] : List Int).map markerCheck)
observed_output: ([true, true, true, true, true, true, true], true, true, [true, true, true])
expected_output: ([true, true, true, true, true, true, true], true, true, [true, true, true])
